anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broadly convex, hemispherical arc visible on the anterior-dorsal boundary of the cranial region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion; visible length is roughly equivalent to base width due to anterior-facing foreshortening.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinctive concave notch at the transition point between the lower melon boundary and the upper rostrum margin.
